name: 03_failed_run_read
description: Why a pipeline failed is answered from the latest run and the error the orchestrator recorded on it, and nothing is changed. The wording is close enough to a declared trigger that the request is routed without a model call.

provider_script.expect_contains: why did the nightly orders pipeline fail

operations.purpose: read the pipeline, its schedule and its owner
read the latest run and the error it stopped on

response.reply_intent: report which run failed, at which task, and the error the orchestrator recorded

response.reply: The latest run of orders_nightly, run-0412, failed at the load_orders task while loading the 2026-03-10 partition: the load into orders_daily timed out after 900 seconds waiting for a table lock held by another session. The pipeline is active, so it will run again at 02:00 UTC on its own.

turns.user: why did the nightly orders pipeline fail
